title: Defense governing-council duties for advanced AI security
last_action: Enacted in the FY2025 National Defense Authorization Act.
summary: Directs the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council to identify and assess AI models that could pose national-security risk if accessed by an adversary, develop strategies against unauthorized adversary access and use, and recommend legislative or administrative action.
committee_dynamics: The provision was enacted through the annual defense authorization process.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

responsible_agencies: Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council

agency_status.detail: The provision establishes continuing governing-council duties; no discrete completion deadline is specified in section 225.

sources.title: Public Law 118-159 — FY2025 National Defense Authorization Act
